name: Hoargate Watch
title: The Crown's Cold Post
examine: Steel under three layers of wool, and frost in the beard of it. Nobody is posted here twice by accident.
lines: Gate's open. It being open is not the same as it being advice.
Six of us on the wall, four on the stair, and the wall is the easy duty.
You want the far side, you go in daylight and you go loud.
